newsitem.title: USA: Citibank plans electronic banking centers.
newsitem.headline: Citibank plans electronic banking centers.

text.p: Citicorp's Ciitibank said Wednesday it plans to open two electronic banking centers in New York City which will be outfitted with two-way video banking systems.
Citibank said the video banking systems will be supported by other electronic components capable of making ready-to-use Citicards and dispensing personalized checks on the spot.
Citibank said each electronic branch will have on-site customer relationship managers who will be on duty during the daytime.
The new centers will provide automated teller machine (ATM) services 24 hours a day, seven days a week, as well as video banking services on a round-the-clock basis.
Citibank said one of the branches will be located in Harlem at 135th Street and Frederick Douglas Blvd, and the other in the Northwest Bronx at a site to be designated.

Citicorp said smaller versions of the electronic banking centers were unveiled earlier this year at the Embarcadero Center in San Francisco and the Northbrook Court Mall in Illinois. Each of the new centers will occupy about 2,000 square feet of space.
